description: Jaye Tyler’s aggressively low-expectation life is disrupted by animal-shaped objects that talk to her, sending her into strangers’ problems and gradually making detachment much less convenient.

s01e01.description: A wax lion begins talking to Jaye, and its cryptic command drags her into a stranger’s problem despite her determined refusal to care.

s01e02.description: A pink flamingo gives Jaye another baffling instruction, pulling her into a chain of events that makes staying uninvolved impossible.

s01e03.description: Jaye’s talking souvenirs steer her toward a woman whose shifting identity and intentions turn a simple encounter into something far stranger.

s01e04.description: A wind-up penguin sends Jaye toward a crisis involving faith, family and someone whose certainty is beginning to unravel.

s01e05.description: A talking animal figure pushes Jaye into a problem involving crime and responsibility, with her interference producing consequences nobody planned.

s01e06.description: A buffalo figurine’s message entangles Jaye with a woman whose habits and isolation make helping her much harder than the instruction sounded.

s01e07.description: Jaye follows another animal command and becomes involved with a man whose attempt to reinvent himself collides with the life he left behind.

s01e08.description: A donkey figurine points Jaye toward romantic trouble, forcing her to meddle in a relationship while her own feelings become harder to ignore.

s01e09.description: A canary’s warning sends Jaye into a situation where trying to keep someone safe creates a new set of risks and misunderstandings.

s01e10.description: A pig figurine pulls Jaye into a tangle of dishonesty where discovering who is lying proves less useful than understanding why.

s01e11.description: A cocktail bunny’s instruction lands Jaye in another social mess, mixing family pressure, attraction and unintended consequences.

s01e12.description: A totem animal leads Jaye into a conflict involving identity and obligation, with her usual reluctant interference becoming unexpectedly personal.

s01e13.description: The animals’ instructions converge on a final problem that forces Jaye to confront what her strange gift has done to her relationships and choices.
